details: This package is a CTF dependency-resolution proof of concept. Its postinstall hook (node probe.cjs) probes a local challenge application on loopback ports 1337, 3000, 8080, 5000 and 80 at /api/modules/ECT-987654, and only continues when the response manifest identifies the expected challenge application. It then looks for a challenge flag by checking the FLAG and HTB_FLAG environment variables and reading /flag, /flag.txt, /app/flag, /app/flag.txt, /home/node/flag.txt, /home/app/flag.txt and /opt/app/flag.txt for an HTB{...} value, and writes the result back into the challenge manifest with an HTTP PUT to the same loopback endpoint. All network activity is confined to 127[.]0[.]0[.]1; nothing is sent to an external host, and no credentials, tokens or user files are collected.
